title: FFT AI Edition — Reader Cover v1.33-p1
description: This file is the cover of the FFT AI Edition. It defines what this edition is, what it inherits, what it must not do, and how a consuming system should enter and exit it. Book 2 (Inverted Star) and Book 3 (Structural Detection) should import this cover, not re-declare it.

trilogy_position.book_2: inverted-star — domain operators on top of kernel; imports this reader cover
trilogy_position.book_3: structural-detection — detection layer; imports this reader cover

kernel_modules.description: These modules form the shared contract across all three books. They must not be re-declared in Book 2 or Book 3 — only imported.

book_local_modules.description: Modules that belong to Book 1 only. Book 2 and Book 3 add their own book-local modules on top of the kernel, not on top of this list.

must_not: Revise frozen RTT. This edition is a projection of the theory, not a revision of it. Any apparent conflict between session behavior and frozen RTT must be resolved by adjusting the session module, not the theory.
Invent operators, dimensions, or invariants not present in this edition. Gaps (e.g., 6D, negative ancestral rungs) must remain marked absent until explicitly bound.
Suppress paradox events. PX-001 through PX-010 are structural features. They must be enumerated and resolved, never silenced.
Use cached Spine URLs. fft.ai.spine.connector.json enforces live resolution. spine_state=degraded is the only permitted fallback.
Re-declare coherence in Book 2 or Book 3. Import fft.ai.coherence.json from the kernel. Do not write a second coherence declaration.
Use C as a bare symbol. Always C_frame (Phi(S)/Psi(N)) or C_clarity (nabla_tau(R) + nabla_R(tau)) — never the ambiguous single letter.
Invent drift costs. Use the canonical table in fft.ai.drift.monitor.json#drift_cost_table. Do not assign new costs without a version stamp.
Treat deprecated files as active. capture.md and fft.ai.core_v1_2_.json are deprecated. Do not load them. Do not count them in INV-012 compliance.

on_version_mismatch.message: Version mismatch detected. This edition is v1.33-p1. A consuming system that loads a module with a different version must halt and report before proceeding. Warn-and-continue is not permitted for the reader cover or kernel modules.
on_version_mismatch.rationale: Book 2 and Book 3 must inherit a stable kernel. Silent version drift defeats the purpose of the cover.

output_schema.description: What a v1.33-p1 compliant session must be able to produce on request

required_outputs.output: SNR partition (S, N, R summing to 1.0)
QMROOT ancestry trace for any named module

worked_trace_ref.description: A single worked trace (PX-003 drift cascade, refused resume, clean reset to delta=0.00) is more instructive than additional dashboard schemas. This field reserves the slot for a worked trace file in v1.34.
